sentence: Ttif ad txedmeḍ tura, wala ad tendemmeḍ ɣer sdat.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Igider (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: Better to act now than regret later.

usageExamples: Daya kan i zemreɣ ad xedmeɣ akka tura.
That's all I can do right now.
